rules.heading: THINGS TO BE REJECTED IN DOING ALL THE AUSPICIOUS DEEDS

planetary.freeform: Lagna or Ascendant and Navamsha occupied by the Moon and malefic planets (emaciated Moon, Sun, Mars, Saturn), third part of a Ghati or 20 Palas before and after mid day and mid night, Navamsha of a malefic planet, three days before an eclipse, seven days after a portent, an eclipse, the whole day of an auspicious portent, nakshatras cleaved by planets, nakshatras in planetary war, or nakshatras with an utpaata or portent (rejected for six months)

exclusions: Lagna occupied by Moon and malefics
Navamsha occupied by Moon and malefics
mid day and mid night central ghati period
nakshatras with planetary war, cleavage, or portents
rules.notes: Lists general astrological conditions, times, and celestial afflictions that must be avoided for all auspicious activities.
